title: Bulacan-made Asean cultural displays move to Manila theater

blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS, Bulacan — Cultural displays showcasing the heritage of Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, created by a Bulacan-based art group for the recent Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, are now on display at the Metropolitan Theater in Manila. The five Likhang Filipino courtyard installations were originally set up at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City for the spouses of Asean leaders and their delegations during the Nov. 16-18 summit. Stage 4 Design, a Malolos-based art exhibition group, completed the transfer and installation of the displays on Saturday night, Nov. 21, said project coordinator Jericho Tanig. READ: […]...
